remarks:
Nestled within the private recreational community of the Little Valley Rod & Gun Club, this charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath seasonal cottage is the perfect lakeside escape for outdoor enthusiasts. A spacious screened-in porch welcomes you into the inviting open-concept living area, where soaring cathedral ceilings and a striking brick fireplace create a warm and cozy gathering space. The rustic kitchen features a wood-burning stove, adding timeless cottage character and charm. The first floor offers a comfortable bedroom, a full bath, and a convenient laundry area, while the second level features a loft-style hallway overlooking the living room and leading to two generously sized bedrooms. Set directly on the lake, this property boasts a private dock, making it easy to spend your days fishing, kayaking, or simply relaxing on the water. Gather around the fire pit in the evenings and enjoy peaceful lake views with family and friends. 
As part of this exclusive community, you'll have access to outstanding recreational amenities, including a beautiful sandy beach for swimming and sunbathing, a waterfront diving board and slide, a community playground, and a pavilion that's perfect for picnics, gatherings, and special occasions. Miles of scenic trails wind throughout the property, offering exceptional hiking and opportunities to enjoy the area's natural beauty. Conveniently located just minutes from Ellicottville, Holiday Valley Resort, and I-86, this seasonal retreat provides easy access to skiing, golf, shopping, dining, and year-round recreation, while offering the peace and tranquility of a private lakeside setting. Whether you're looking for a weekend getaway, a family retreat, or your own outdoor haven, this cozy cabin combines rustic charm, comfortable living, and an exceptional recreational lifestyle in a truly picturesque location. Included with sale are 2 ATVs.
